mapper.select: SELECT tbm.fnumber contractCode, tbc1.FNUMBER clientCode, tbc.FNAME_L2 currency, ga.FNUMBER accountNumber, ga.FNAME_L2 accountName, gba.FENDBALANCEFOR endBalanceFor, gba.FBEGINBALANCEFOR beginBalanceFor, toc.FNUMBER orgId, gba.FPERIOD period FROM HXORACLE.T_GL_AssistBalance_5F GBA LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_ORG_COMPANY toc ON toc.FID =gba.FORGUNITID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_ACCOUNTVIEW GA ON GBA.FACCOUNTID = GA.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_CURRENCY tbc ON gba.FCURRENCYID =tbc.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_ASSISTANTHG GS ON GBA.FASSISTGRPID =GS.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_MATERIAL tbm ON GS.FMATERIALID =TBM.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_CUSTOMER tbc1 ON GS.FCUSTOMERID =TBC1.FID WHERE GBA.FPERIOD = #{period} -- AND toc.FNUMBER IN ('01-C0001') AND GA.FNUMBER IN ('1532.01','1531.01.03') -- AND tbm.FNUMBER ='L21B108610'

SELECT gv.FID fid,toc.FNUMBER orgId,tbp.FNUMBER period, tbm.fnumber contractCode,tbc1.FNUMBER clientCode , --ga.FASSGRPID ,tbc.FNAME_L2 "CurrencyNAME" , ga1.FNUMBER accountNumber,ga1.FNAME_L2 accountName, gv.FABSTRACT fabStract, NULLIF(DECODE(GE.FENTRYDC, '1', COALESCE(GA.FLOCALAMOUNT,GE.FLOCALAMOUNT), '0'), 0) dtAmount,--凭证分录借方金额 NULLIF(DECODE(GE.FENTRYDC, '0', COALESCE(GA.FLOCALAMOUNT,GE.FLOCALAMOUNT), '0'), 0) crAmount --凭证分录贷方金额 --toc.FNUMBER "ORGID",GV.FTOC.FNAME_L2 "ORGNAME",tbp.FNUMBER "PeriodName" ,GE.*,GV.* FROM HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHER GV INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_ORG_COMPANY toc ON toc.FID =gv.FCOMPANYID INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_PERIOD TBP ON TBP.FID =gv.FPERIODID INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHERENTRY GE ON GV.FID = GE.FBILLID INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_CURRENCY tbc ON GE.FCURRENCYID =tbc.FID LEFT JOIN HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHERASSISTRECORD GA ON GE.FID =GA.FENTRYID LEFT JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_ASSISTANTHG HG ON HG.FID =GA.FASSGRPID INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_ACCOUNTVIEW GA1 ON GE.FACCOUNTID =GA1.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_MATERIAL tbm ON HG.FMATERIALID =TBM.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_CUSTOMER tbc1 ON HG.FCUSTOMERID =TBC1.FID WHERE tbp.FNUMBER BETWEEN #{startPeriod} AND #{endPeriod} and gv.FBIZSTATUS =5 AND tbm.fnumber = #{contractCode} AND (gv.FABSTRACT LIKE '确认%收益' or gv.FABSTRACT LIKE '计提%收益') AND ga1.FNUMBER in ('1532.01', '1505.03.02')
